events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot and killed in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, he would have been 55.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost him, Tupac's influence on music and culture is still undeniable. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Crossing the Road
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have been rocking stages for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger after all these years.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: Over five decades on, the message of John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates. A truly timeless song.

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs could you fit on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune? We're ready for a debate.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, experimental classic unlike anything else. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen frontman and rock icon Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61 today! This album marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980, he would have been 86.

angles.name: Gone But Not Forgotten
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to live on.
